newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end higher, just off peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end higher, just off peaks.

text.p: April 8 - U.S. stock index futures ended higher but just off peaks. June S&P 500s bounced on paper buying, shortcovering after T-bond futures managed to shave losses late. Some said unconfirmed talk that a prominent market strategist said the downward correction is over added lift. Sellers emerged near peaks, some look for challenge of last week's high at 777.00.
